name: commerce
description: Garden commerce cap: lock-page purchase zone, /purchase/, /pricing/, and /privacy/. Product cards use Offer Surface tokens (--mdf-offer-*). Connection via commerce.enable + services.mdfriday + mdfCommerce*.
entry: layouts/_default/purchase.html (Gate) | pricing.html | privacy.html | partial:commerce-purchase-gate.html | partial:access-card.html purchase slot | partial:commerce-privacy-link.html

params.description: When true, plugin ensures pricing/purchase/privacy ordinary pages.
projects.id (p_<hex>); empty before first publish — purchase zone stays hidden.

css.note: Set --mdf-offer-* on .mdf-commerce / #mdf-pricing-root / .mdf-offer (see docs/offer-tokens.md). Do not fork the file unless rewriting Offer Surface.

js.note: Lock-page offers, checkout confirm, /purchase/ four states, /pricing/, /privacy/ runtime fill. Cards expose .mdf-offer* aliases.

assets.size_impact: ~18KB uncompressed; scripts request offers only when mdfCommerce.ready

locked.reason: commerce.js and the public commerce API depend on these ids. Themes may style them; never rename.

partials.note: Gate framework for /purchase/. Keep #mdf-purchase-root and mdfCommerceAttrs data-msg-*.
Must keep locked access and commerce ids.
Place in the family footer; do not rename the href source.

activation_pattern.template: "capabilities": { "commerce": true }  // garden families ship this cap; connection is plugin-owned via commerce.enable + services.mdfriday
